info.name: Alnoor API
info.description: Complete API collection for the Alnoor Educational Management System. This collection includes all endpoints for authentication, registration, user management, and academic structure management.

request.description: Fetches the CSRF token and sets it in the cookies. This must be called before any POST/PUT/DELETE request.
Authenticates a user via session. Returns `requires_2fa: true` if 2FA is needed (for admin roles).
Verifies the 6-digit 2FA code sent to the admin's email after initial login.
Logs out the current user and invalidates the session.
Returns detailed information about the authenticated user, including roles, preferred role, and user types.
Sends a UUID token to the user's email for password reset. Token expires in 10 minutes.
Resets the password using the token from the email.
Allows an authenticated user to change their password.
Sends a verification code to the new email address. The code expires in 5 minutes.
Confirms the email change using the verification code.
Creates a new Account with specified roles. An email with credentials is sent to the user.
Activates an Account for an existing Person. Creates a User record and links it to the Person.
Lists all accounts (Admin only).
Retrieves a specific account by its ID.
Assigns a role to an account.
Sets the current user's preferred role (role ID).
Submits a new registration request. For new users, the `person` object is required.

item.name: Submit Registration (Public - Existing Person by Identifier)

request.description: Submits a registration for an existing person using their email/phone/telegram_id and birth_date.
Tracks the status of a registration request using the tracking code.
Approves a pending registration. This action creates an Account, User, and Student for the applicant.
Rejects a pending registration request.
Creates registration settings for a program.
Lists notifications visible to the current user. Admins see all; other users see broadcast or role-targeted notifications.
Retrieves a specific notification by ID.
Creates a broadcast notification visible to ALL authenticated users. Admin only.
Creates a notification targeted to specific roles using role codes (e.g., 'student', 'teacher'). Admin only.
Creates a notification targeted to specific roles using role IDs. Admin only.
Updates an existing notification. Admin only.
Partially updates a notification (e.g., only the message). Admin only.
Deletes a notification. Admin only.
